title: Make time-sync trust vectors independent and cross-implementation
description: Security review found packets-timing vectors are generated by importing the implementation under test and omit the trust state machine. Create literal/independently derived versioned vectors for positive and negative authorization, payload/provenance mismatch, replay/freshness, correction/cumulative bounds, provision rollback/recovery, and unique option IDs; validate Python, Rust, and Zephyr/C against the same expected wire bytes and decisions.
notes: Post-fix correctness review: trust/provision literals are not executed against TimeSample/StratumTracker/evaluate_epoch_floor, while source/stratum mappings are still generated from implementation. Add executable independent adapters and exact committed-vs-generator reproduction covering real DIO envelope, board identity/version, projected lead, idle/invalid-candidate expiry, correction bounds, refresh and NO_SYNC in Python plus cross-implementation consumers.
